fact: ANATS's director-general says the government has deployed an integrated population and secure-titles management system whose base is the registre national biométrique des populations, designed to guarantee each person's uniqueness.

The Ministry of Finance and ANATS signed a protocol giving the ministry a secured channel to consult data from the registre national biométrique des populations for identification and verification in administrative, budgetary and financial processes, and the ANATS director-general says all public and private administrations will be able to connect to it.

Tchadinfos reports that on 10 March 2026 the finance ministry and ANATS signed a memorandum for consulting data from the national biometric population register, which ANATS's director general described as an essential tool guaranteeing the uniqueness of each citizen's identity.
